verdict.rationale: Algolia is a hosted search platform, so an official MCP server applies, and the evidence shows one exists. Its docs index lists an "MCP Server" section, the official algolia/skills repo ships an `algolia-mcp` skill for search, analytics, and recommendations via the Algolia MCP server, and the quickstart points agent builders to "Build with AI". Missing for 10: setup/connection instructions, the list of exposed tools and auth details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
